newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Deloitte & Touche to audit Bulgarian National Bank.
newsitem.headline: Deloitte & Touche to audit Bulgarian National Bank.

text.p: International auditors Deloitte & Touche have been chosen to audit the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) after winning a tender among five auditing firms, Bulgaria's finance minister said on Tuesday.

"Deloitte & Touche were chosen because they made the most acceptable offer for performing the audit and they have a rich experience in auditing central banks," Dimitar Kostov told reporters after a session of the BNB's plenary council composed of BNB, cabinet and parliament officials.
The audit is expected to start on September 16 and be completed by October 31, the BNB said in a statement.
Deloitte & Touche competed with Arthur Andersen, Price Waterhouse, BDO Binder and KPMG, the BNB said in a statement.

Carrying out an annual international audit of the BNB was among the requirements of the International Monetary Fund, which sealed a $580 million standby loan agreement with Bulgaria in July. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
